question: 'Wings of Fire' is an autobiography of whom?
solution:
The correct answer is **APJ Abdul Kalam**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wings of Fire** is an autobiography of Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam, the 11th President of India.
 
• It details his early life, effort, hardship, fortitude, luck, and chance that eventually led him to lead Indian space research, nuclear and missile programs.
 
• The book was first published in 1999 and has been translated into various languages.
 
• It is co-authored by Arun Tiwari, a scientist who worked with Dr. Kalam.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1: Ratan Tata
 Ratan Tata is an Indian industrialist, philanthropist, and former chairman of Tata Sons.
 
 

 Option 2: Indira Gandhi
 Indira Gandhi was the first and only female Prime Minister of India, serving four terms.
 
 

 Option 3: Subhash Chandra Bose
 Subhash Chandra Bose was an Indian nationalist whose defiant patriotism made him a hero in India.
